name: Mini Notes
tagline: Tiny notes with an LLM summary — Anna storage + Executa sampling.
description: Mini Notes is a minimal Anna App. Create, view and delete short notes; every read/write goes through the Anna storage Host API (anna.storage.get / anna.storage.set). One click of Summarize routes through anna.tools.invoke to a bundled Executa tool, which borrows the host LLM via reverse JSON-RPC sampling/createMessage. No own API keys, no side-channel storage.
_comment: Local development only needs manifest.json + executas/; app.json carries listing metadata used by `anna-app apps publish`.
